name: code-map
description: Structural map of a codebase: top-level definitions (functions, classes, types) per file via per-language patterns, or a token-budgeted repo map with --map. Cheap orientation before reading.
use_when: mapping a module's top-level symbols or a repo outline

args.name: --map
args.description: Print a compact repo map (text) instead of JSON.

stdout: JSON {file: [{line, text}]} — or text repo-map with --map.
notes: Heuristic (regex), not a real parser — covers common top-level forms for py/js/ts/go/rs/java/kt/c/cpp/rb/sh/lua/swift.
